summary: Linked-list node removal by identifier. Searches the container's node chain for a node whose data pointer equals a2, unlinks it, and fixes up head (this+0), tail (this+4) and cursor (this+8) pointers when the removed node is one of them. Decrements the element count (this+0xC). Optionally clears the node's release flag (node+8) when a3 is zero; when the release flag is set, calls the data object's vtable method at offset +4 with a refcount of 1, then frees the node wrapper via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns 1 when removed, 0 when not found or a2 is null.

operations.description: Guard on a2 being non-null; returns 0 when the identifier is null.
Start traversal at the head node stored at this+0; result initialised to 0.
Walk the next-link chain reading node+4; stop when a node's data pointer at node+0 equals a2 or the chain ends.
When traversal reaches a null next link the node is not present; return 0.
When the removed node is the cursor stored at this+8, advance the cursor to the removed node's next link.
Unlink the node: predecessor's next link (or head this+0 when no predecessor) is set to the removed node's next link.
When the removed node is the tail stored at this+4, set the tail to the predecessor.
Decrement the element count at this+0xC.
When a3 is zero, clear the release flag byte at node+8.
Guard on the release flag byte at node+8; when set and the data pointer at node+0 is non-null, invoke the data object's vtable method at offset +4 passing refcount 1.
Free the node wrapper through FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zero the removed node's metadata dword at node+0xC during removal handling.
Return 1 after a successful removal, 0 when a2 is null or the node is absent.
